holding_episode_definition: maximal consecutive run of an identical non-zero position across the complete chronological sample; not reset at session or calendar-year boundaries
neighborhood_definition: axis-adjacent configurations differing by exactly one declared grid step in one parameter while the other two parameters remain unchanged
position_timing: position at bar t equals signal from bar t-1
signal_timing: signal uses information available through bar t
transaction_cost_convention: net_return = gross_return - turnover * cost_bps_per_turnover / 10000; direct reversal turnover equals 2
whipsaw_definition: non-zero episode lasting no more than four bars, followed by the next opposite non-zero episode starting within four positional bars
